Trace, implement and test: leetcode1238 circular permutation in binary representation sol2

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
#include<vector>
#include<algorithm>
#include<iostream>
using namespace std;

class Solution {
public:
    vector<int> circularPermutation(int n, int start) {
        int len = 1 << n; /* n: 格雷码中bit位的个数 */
        vector<int> grey(len, 0);
        int startPos = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++)
        {
            grey[i] = i ^ (i >> 1);
            if (grey[i] == start)  /* 由于格雷码数组中每一个数都是不相等的, 所以这里加不加break语句都行 */
                startPos = i;
        }
        vector<int> res(grey.begin() + startPos, grey.end());
        res.insert(res.end(), grey.begin(), grey.begin() + startPos);
        return res;
    }
};

// Test
int main()
{
    Solution sol;
    int n = 2, start = 3;
    auto res = sol.circularPermutation(n, start);
    for (auto x : res)
        cout << x << " ";
    return 0;
}
